unique_public_sensitivity: Group eligible rows within environment by public_sha256. Retain lexicographically smallest anonymous case_id per group. Flag conflicting reference labels. Repeat paired instance-block bootstrap; this is secondary and cannot replace the primary result. Also report distinct per-arm full Judge input hashes.
semantic_audit: All blocks containing any Qwen or Jev T/F classification change, plus ceil(10% of unchanged eligible blocks) separately per environment. Order unchanged blocks by SHA256("tgf-semantic-audit-v1|" + smallest anonymous case_id in block); audit all eligible cases in selected blocks. This deterministic rule is fixed before inspecting outputs.
audit_disclosure: Assistant source review, not independent human gold. Check question premise, authorization-relevant answer claims, original source support, timing and cumulative totals; classification accuracy is separate from claim support.
strategy_cost: Report collection separately. Per independent deployment: P=final judgment; C=one fixed Qwen review+final; F/T=one Actor followup+final. Do not apply shared-evidence discount. Per-model tokens and inference/request latency; actual GPU allocation separately. Original CPU selection/ledger runtime was not metered, so disclose it instead of inventing values.
